latestVersion.changelog:
Initial public release of Editor Online Best — Edit and Export Videos Online.

- Enables online video editing of MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB with cloud-based processing and 1080p MP4 export.
- No installation required; all rendering and editing run on remote GPU nodes.
- Supports quick start with automatic backend connection and free token retrieval for new users.
- Simple, guided workflows: upload raw clips, describe edits, and download polished exports within minutes.
- Offers credit-based usage, session management, and built-in error handling for authentication, file limits, and export restrictions.
- Designed for content creators who need fast, accessible online video editing without software setup.
